host_selection: Existing verified conditional reference joint rows; no new fit or posterior selection
population: BH species only; local independent frozen bath
density_radius: Radius at which total BH mass density equals half its central value
local_scale: L=min(density_radius,rho_BH/abs(d rho_BH/dr)); at zero derivative use density_radius
sigma_convention: Number-weighted BH mean squared speed divided by three; anisotropic DF retained in integrals

closest_approach.prescription: rp_min=max(100 GM/c^2,10 r_cap(w)); b_min^2=rp_min^2+2GM rp_min/w^2; empty annuli have zero allowed rate
closest_approach.scope: Declared Newtonian elastic domain motivated by leading parabolic radiation loss; not a capture calibration
closest_approach.excluded_channel: Record incoming flux below the floor separately; future common unresolved-event hazard, not applied to any trajectory here

radial_velocity_transform: sinh grid with scale=min(sqrt(s2j)); full local DF support
interpretation: Finite-domain local moments and sampled increments, not trajectories or residence. Cutoff variations are conditional controls, not fitted physical values.
residence_prediction_status: Not evaluated; continuous-generator response requires a converged trajectory discretization.
